messages.subject: Occasional error with 'rstarts = 10'
parts:
Hi,

I have been using the recently added feature of trying out multiple starting values (https://lavaan.ugent.be/history/dot6.html), specifically 'rstarts = 10'. When running multiple models using for loop, the loop occasionally stops with an error saying error in x.noerror[sapply(x.rstarts, "attr", "converged")] : invalid subscript type 'list'. But that is automatically resolved (?) when I restart the loop from where the error occurred. Would there be a way to fix this?

Thanks,
Yun
